description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core Razor PageModel for editing catalog items in an e-commerce web application. It handles authorization, binding of the catalog item data, retrieval on GET requests, and updating the catalog item asynchronously on POST requests.

classes.name: EditCatalogItemModel
classes.description: A PageModel class for editing catalog items, managing data binding, authorization, and handling GET and POST requests for updating catalog items.

methods.name: EditCatalogItemModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the catalog item view model service dependency.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests, initializing the CatalogModel property with the provided catalog item data.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to update the catalog item asynchronously if the model state is valid and redirects to the admin index page.
